eligibility: hidden combination has every component observed at least once in visible data

scoring.component_memory: visible global + sum mutation effects; each effect=(mutation visible mean-global)*n/(n+1)
scoring.full_lightning: component memory plus pair residual memory; pair residual=(visible residual after component memory mean)*n/(n+1); pair contributions averaged with recurrence weight n/(n+1)

split: FNV1a32(canonical mutation set) mod 10; 0-6 visible, 7-9 hidden
success_rule: Full beats component-memory on >=3/4 design-selection metrics (Top1, Top5, enrichment, regret), enrichment >1, and shuffle |Spearman|<0.05.
